title: dbt Test Result Trend
dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results (`soda:scan`), dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.
app: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom warehouse data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=dbt:run_results resource_type=test
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as tests, sum(eval(status IN ("fail","error"))) as failures by _time
| eval pass_rate=round(100*(tests-failures)/tests,1)
| sort _time
description: Trends the overall dbt data-quality pass rate over time so the health of the transformation layer is visible as a single, tracked KPI.
value: A slowly declining test pass rate signals eroding data quality before any single failure is alarming; the trend is an early governance signal.
implementation: Emit run results to HEC; schedule daily; chart the pass-rate trend and review in data-quality reviews.
visualization: Timechart of daily pass rate, table of worst days.
grandmaExplanation: We track how often your data passes its quality checks over time, so a slow slide in quality is noticed early.
